items.text: Infact,the end point of a titration of aweak acid and a weak base cannot be determined using an acid-base indicator The end point of such a titration is best determined by measuring the temperature changes (thermometric titration) or electrical conductivity changes (conductometric titration).

items.text: A diprotic acid is an acid that produces two H+ions per acid molecule.Examples ofdiprotic acids are sulfuric acid, H,SO4, and carbonic acid, HCO3.
